Unleash Open Source is free and has no seat limit. Enterprise annual contracts are quoted per customer and invoiced.
Is there a free version of Unleash?

Yes. Unleash Open Source is free, self-hosted, and has no limit on seats. It covers the core feature set, with a limit of 1 project, 2 environments, and 5,000 feature flags per instance. Thousands of teams run it in production.

It does not include single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, granular role-based access control, change request approvals, or a support SLA. If you need those, or you would rather not operate the service yourself, Pay-As-You-Go starts at $75 per seat per month with a 14-day free trial.

The Pay-As-You-Go plan on Unleash Cloud includes 53 million API requests per month. Additional requests are billed at $5 per million.

Pay-As-You-Go is self-service: $75 per seat per month, monthly credit card billing, no contract, standard support with a one business day response target, and a 99.9% uptime commitment. Best for teams that want to start immediately without procurement.
